context: The bounded end-to-end proof: drive both surfaces through Reverso's real ASGI apps against the live upstream, quantify the double-translation cost for tool_use, and file any defect found rather than fixing it here.
root_causes: The double-translation cost of Anthropic to Responses to Anthropic was asserted in the plan but never measured.
The endpoint deny-list was measured with a bare text message, so feature support ON an endpoint was never distinguished from reachability OF that endpoint.
evidence: kimi-k3 returned exactly one parsed tool call with the correct name on BOTH the Responses and Anthropic surfaces, with a proper thinking block on the Anthropic side.
glm-5 returns 200 with tools on the Responses surface and 502 on the Anthropic surface, reproducibly across three runs.
Isolated upstream probe: glm-5 /messages returns 200 without tools and 400 invalid_request_error with tools; the same tool declaration succeeds on /chat/completions.
Scoped across all 22 /messages-capable ids, 11 reject Anthropic-format tools.
Tool support and output_config support are almost perfectly anti-correlated: 9 ids accept tools and reject output_config, 9 the reverse, 2 both, 2 neither.
No request in the proof was rate limited, so live 429 behaviour was not observed.
solutions: Ship a reusable in-process proof driver that needs no running gateway daemon, so the proof is repeatable rather than a one-off transcript.
Commit the measured result as an artifact and gate it against the shipped deny-list so the two cannot silently diverge.
File the tools gap with its reproduction and a suggested tool-aware fix, per this goal's file-not-fix contract.
Record the unobserved 429 path as not-yet-observed rather than claiming coverage from unit tests.
acceptance_criteria: Both surfaces complete a real tool-bearing turn, recorded as evidence.
The double-translation cost is quantified rather than asserted.
The recorded proof covers every catalog id.
The endpoint deny-list matches the recorded measurement, gated by test.
The tools gap is filed with a reproduction and stays visible in the artifact.
Tool support and output_config support are asserted independent, so neither is inferred from the other.
Quota behaviour is recorded honestly, including that it was not observed live.
legacy_risk_reason: adds no product code path, but commits an evidence artifact that gates the shipped endpoint deny-list; a wrong artifact would license a wrong routing decision
